newsitem.title: FRANCE: Council of State confirms Lagardere appeal.
newsitem.headline: Council of State confirms Lagardere appeal.

text.p: The French Council of State on Friday confirmed that Lagardere Groupe had registered an appeal earlier this week against a decision of the independent Privatisation Commission concerning Thomson SA .
"An appeal has been registered," a court official at the Council of State, France's highest administrative court, told Reuters.
She added that no date had been set for any hearing by the council.
"It will not be judged immediately," she said.

Lagardere has made the appeal against a decision by the Privatisation Commission not to issue a response conforming to an earlier government decision to sell state-owned Thomson SA to Lagardere and Daewoo Electronics.
Thomson SA includes 58 percent in defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF and 100 percent of consumer electronics group Thomson Multimedia (TMM).
The government had said in October that the Lagardere/Daewoo team was the "preferred bidder" over Alcatel Alsthom and asked the Privatisation Commission to seal the decision.

The Privatisation Commission said in December that it was not fully convinced that the sale of TMM to Daewoo would give the best job guarantees and it was also sceptical whether the deal fully valued TMM's technological know-how.
Following the Privatisation Commission decision, the government suspended the privatisation plan of Thomson SA.
It had since decided to sell Thomson-CSF and Thomson Multimedia separately and is expected to decide before the end of February on the method of the sale -- private placement, tender or market float.
